issues.where: 3_tech az000 neck ring; 1_beauty back34 and hero nape; 2_closeups head colour, top-right ruff edge
issues.what: piece_ruff is still one uniform ring: a flat top rim runs right round the neck as a shelf, painted body grey against the dark saddle so it shows as a lighter band behind the ears; it reads as a collar, not a mane.
issues.fix: Stage 3: rebuild piece_ruff as 3-4 overlapping clumps of unequal length (+-25%); taper the top-rear edge to zero thickness along the spine and sink it 20% of neck width into the nape; keep full thickness (>= 25% neck width) only at the sides and the chest bib; paint the top faces the saddle dark grey where they meet the saddle.
issues.check: 3_tech az000 shows no horizontal rim across the nape; back34 nape is one skull-to-withers line at 128 px; ruff hit/float/zfight 0.

issues.where: 1_beauty az000 between the forelegs below the cream bib; hero under the bib
issues.what: a dark grey pointed wedge hangs below the V of the bib and reads as a dangling flap or a third leg at thumbnail size.
issues.fix: Stage 2: raise the single dropped sternum vertex back to the brisket line and spread the drop over the 2-3 bottom chest verts each side so the keel is a rounded curve. Stage 3: paint the sternum faces cream on the existing loop so the bib closes at the leg line.
issues.check: az000 at 128 px shows no dark point below the bib; az090 chest depth stays >= 1.3x waist; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 2_closeups front limb and hind limb colour; 1_beauty hero forelegs
issues.what: the tan paw is wider than the cannon with a ledge at its top rim (a boot), and the body's lowest loop still steps over the near foreleg with a shadow line.
issues.fix: Stage 2: scale each paw's top ring down to the cannon width and widen the pastern 10% so paw and cannon blend; slide the body's lowest loop up and in over each foreleg top by ~5% of chest depth.
issues.check: front-limb close-up shows no ledge at the paw top and no horizontal shadow at the leg top; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 2_closeups head colour, eye
issues.what: the socket is a black hollow ~1.4x the eye; the amber reads as a bead in a hole, with a stray white sliver at its front edge.
issues.fix: Stage 3: scale piece_eye 1.2x and move it outward by half its thickness; paint the socket inset ~25% value dark grey, not black.
issues.check: head close-up: amber fills >= 2/3 of the socket and no white sliver; az000 still shows two eyes; eye float 0.

issues.where: 2_closeups front limb and toes colour
issues.what: four equal tan nubs with black tips, each ~1/6 of the paw width, in a straight row: a comb.
issues.fix: Stage 3: make the two middle toes 15-20% longer, splay the outer toes +-8 deg, widen each pad to ~1/5 of the paw width.
issues.check: toe close-up: the middle toes lead; toes zfight 0.

issues.where: 2_closeups hind limb colour, flank above the near hind leg
issues.what: a concave pocket of dark facets sits on the flank in front of the thigh and reads as a dent.
issues.fix: Stage 2: move the 2-3 pocket verts outward 3-4% of body width so the flank is convex from the rib cage to the hip.
issues.check: hind-limb close-up shows the flank as one lit plane; valley 0; IoU > 0.9.

palette: grey, dark saddle, cream bib, tan legs from wrist/hock down, amber eyes, black nose pad over a cream lip

issues.where: 1_beauty az090 both flaps and hero front flap; 2_closeups belt and loincloth colour/wire
issues.what: each flap is a straight rigid plate hanging from the belt's outer edge; edge-on it is a stick with ~10 cm of daylight to the thigh and the buttocks, and the close-up shows a flat board with one crease at the top.
issues.fix: Stage 3: rebuild each flap as a two-segment plate bent ~15 deg at 40% of its height: the top segment lies on the belly/thigh (front) and the buttocks (back) with zero gap, the hem segment hangs free; thin from ~4 cm at the belt to ~1.5 cm at the hem; widen the hem 15%.
issues.check: az090 and back34 show no daylight between flap and body over the top half; loincloth float 0, sliver <= 2.

issues.where: 2_closeups head colour, brow top; 1_beauty az090 hand at the hip; 3_tech az000 chest under the jaw and az090 hand
issues.what: a black hairline slit runs the length of the brow shelf; the finger gaps read as three black scratch strokes edge-on; a sliver strip runs along the jaw-chest seam.
issues.fix: Stage 2: slide the brow-top loop fully onto the brow edge and merge it; widen each finger gap to >= 2 cm and chamfer its edges so it reads as a groove; slide the jaw-chest seam loop onto the chest edge.
issues.check: head close-up shows no black line on the brow; az090 shows no dark strokes at the hand; body sliver <= 4 and no yellow at the brow, jaw or hand in 3_tech.

issues.where: 2_closeups fist colour and wire; 1_beauty az000 both fists
issues.what: the fist top is a smooth featureless dome with no knuckle ridge and four identical finger blocks hang below it like a comb; only the thumb reads.
issues.fix: Stage 2: raise four knuckle bumps 3-4 cm at the finger roots with vertex moves; lengthen the middle finger +15% and shorten the little finger -25%; curl all fingertips 20 deg toward the palm.
issues.check: fist close-up silhouette shows a knuckle row and staggered fingertips; az000 shows no comb of equal blocks; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 1_beauty back34 far foot and near hand; hero both feet; az090 near foot
issues.what: toenails and fingernails are flat black rectangles on the digit fronts and read as a grille of slots at thumbnail size.
issues.fix: Stage 3: rebuild each nail as a wedge <= 1/3 of the digit width sunk 1 cm into the digit front, painted mid blue-grey (~35% value) with only the front face darker.
issues.check: back34 at 128 px shows no black rectangles; nails read as caps on the toes; toenails zfight 0.

issues.where: 2_closeups moss and rocks colour/wire; 1_beauty back34 top rock
issues.what: the rocks are regular icosahedra (d20 dice), two touch on the shoulder, and the top rock in back34 stands upright like a horn.
issues.fix: Stage 3: scale each rock non-uniformly (1.0/0.7/0.5), rotate each differently, lay the back34 rock 30 deg flatter with its base sunk 1/3 into the moss, and separate the touching pair by >= 5 cm.
issues.check: rocks close-up shows three different silhouettes with no contact; back34 shows no vertical spike; rocks float 0.

issues.where: 1_beauty back34 back
issues.what: the back is one smooth rounded slab with no spine groove or shoulder blades.
issues.fix: Stage 2: sink the spine-line verts 3-4 cm from the moss to the belt and flatten two shoulder-blade planes angled ~15 deg outward.
issues.check: back34 shows a groove and two blade planes; IoU > 0.9.

issues.where: 2_closeups head colour eyes; 1_beauty az000
issues.what: each eye is a thick amber hexagonal ring around a hexagonal pupil and reads as a hex nut at close range.
issues.fix: Stage 3: rebuild piece_pupil 8-sided at ~65% of the eye width and thin the amber ring to ~1/6 of the eye width.
issues.check: az000 thumbnail: the pupils read first, the ring second; eye float 0.
